Leo · Listen & Shadow 23

What You're Working On — the job, a busy week, the thing you built
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE WORK
👤 Brian
Tell me what you're working on right now.
요즘 뭐 하고 있어?
work on ~ — ~를 작업하다
💬 Leo
I'm working on the viewer side of the app.
지금은 웹툰 뷰어 쪽 작업을 하고 있어.
the ~ side — ~ 쪽, ~ 부분
같은 패턴으로 — I'm working on the payment side. · She's working on the design side.
💬 Leo
It's basically about making the screen people read on faster.
기본적으로 사람들이 보는 화면을 빠르게 만드는 일이야.
basically — 쉽게 말하면
같은 패턴으로 — It's basically about cutting the load time. · It's basically a tool that checks the data.
💬 Leo
It sits between the app and the server.
앱에서 앞단과 서버 사이에 있어.
sit between ~ and ~ — ~와 ~ 사이에 있다
같은 패턴으로 — It sits between design and engineering. · My desk sits between two windows.
👤 Brian
Who decides what you build?
뭘 만들지는 누가 정해?
decide — 정하다
💬 Leo
The way it works is, product brings it, we check if it's doable, then we decide together.
돌아가는 방식은, 기획 쪽에서 가져오고 우리가 가능한지 본 다음에 같이 정해.
the way it works is ~ — 돌아가는 방식은 ~다 · doable — 할 만한
같은 패턴으로 — The way it works is, the client sends a brief first. · The way it works is, everyone votes.
💬 Leo
Day to day, it's mostly reviews and meetings.
일상적으로는 대부분 리뷰랑 회의야.
day to day — 일상적으로
같은 패턴으로 — Day to day, it's mostly email. · Day to day, it's mostly waiting.
PART 2 · A BUSY WEEK
👤 Brian
Was this a busy week?
이번 주 바빴어?
busy — 바쁜
💬 Leo
It piles up when the deadlines land on the same week.
마감이 겹치면 일이 쌓여.
pile up — 쌓이다 · land on ~ — ~에 떨어지다
같은 패턴으로 — It piles up when two people are off. · The work piles up after a holiday.
💬 Leo
Some weeks all of that goes out the window.
어떤 주는 세워둔 게 다 소용없어져.
go out the window — 다 소용없어지다
같은 패턴으로 — Some days the plan goes out the window. · Once it rains, the schedule goes out the window.
💬 Leo
I catch myself checking Slack in bed.
나도 모르게 침대에서 슬랙을 보고 있더라고.
catch myself ~ing — 나도 모르게 ~하고 있다
같은 패턴으로 — I catch myself refreshing the dashboard. · I catch myself thinking about it on the bus.
💬 Leo
It's hard to switch off when something's broken in production.
서버에 뭐가 터지면 스위치가 잘 안 꺼져.
switch off — (일 생각을) 끄다 · production — 실서버
같은 패턴으로 — It's hard to switch off when a deadline's close. · It's hard to switch off after a bad call.
💬 Leo
What helps is writing tomorrow's list before I leave.
도움이 되는 건 퇴근 전에 내일 할 일을 적어두는 거야.
what helps is ~ — 도움이 되는 건 ~다
같은 패턴으로 — What helps is a walk. · What helps is turning the phone over.
💬 Leo
I've gotten better at letting the small stuff wait.
작은 건 미뤄두는 건 예전보다 나아졌어.
let ~ wait — ~는 미뤄두다
같은 패턴으로 — I've gotten better at saying no. · I've gotten better at leaving on time.
PART 3 · THE THING YOU BUILT
👤 Brian
Tell me about the thing you built — what is it, and what does it do?
네가 만든 거 얘기해줘 — 뭐고 뭘 해?
built — 만들었다
💬 Leo
What it does is pull up what people are going to read next.
이게 하는 일은 사람들이 다음에 볼 걸 미리 불러오는 거야.
pull up — 불러오다
같은 패턴으로 — What it does is catch the errors early. · What it does is save you a click.
💬 Leo
It has to handle a lot of traffic without going down.
멈추지 않고 많은 요청을 감당해야 해.
handle — 감당하다 · traffic — 접속량 · go down — 멈추다
같은 패턴으로 — It has to handle Monday mornings without slowing. · It has to work without an internet connection.
💬 Leo
If it goes down, people notice right away.
멈추면 사람들이 바로 알아채.
notice — 알아채다 · right away — 바로
같은 패턴으로 — If it's late, everyone notices. · If the line is down, we hear about it in minutes.
💬 Leo
These days it just runs quietly.
지금은 조용히 잘 돌아가고 있어.
these days — 요즘은 · run — 돌아가다
같은 패턴으로 — These days it needs almost no work. · These days I'm mostly reviewing.
💬 Leo
It's never really done — there's always something left to fix.
완전히 끝나진 않아 — 항상 고칠 게 남아 있어.
never really done — 완전히 끝나지 않는
같은 패턴으로 — A garden is never really done. · The list is never really done.
느리게 20/20 · 보통 20/20
